subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw accept this one-way device-identity cutover, including Doctor-required migration and unsupported downgrade/mixed-version operation for processes sharing one state directory?
rationale: This is an intentional persistent-state and pairing-identity compatibility contract, not a mechanical defect that review automation can safely choose on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept cutover after recovery fix
options.body: Approve the SQLite-only runtime contract once full reset remains usable on identity failure and a real legacy-upgrade/recovery run is attached.

options.title: Require compatible downgrade path
options.body: Defer the merge and require an explicit supported migration or compatibility strategy for old JSON-only binaries sharing the state directory.

options.title: Defer the migration
options.body: Keep the existing identity store until maintainers choose the permanent cross-runtime upgrade policy.

recommendation.title: Accept cutover after recovery fix
recommendation.body: Approve the SQLite-only runtime contract once full reset remains usable on identity failure and a real legacy-upgrade/recovery run is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current migration series and can provide the design context, while final acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
